parameters.content:
## UQU academic degrees only — inactive / dry run
Read README.ar.md before execution. No Campus credential is exported.
Default manual execution only fetches public HTML and produces Final Report.
Live requires mode=live + exact confirmation + reviewed dataset fingerprint + a locally configured UQU-scoped Header Auth credential.
Do not bypass validation/approval or execute the HTTP node in isolation. No schedule, deletion, or publication calls.
Self-hosted Code runners must allow only the crypto built-in module used for the dataset SHA-256.
Keep n8n access and execution-data retention restricted.
